questions.stem: According to the passage, where did the Blue Ghost lander touch down on the moon?
options: On the far side of the moon, away from Earth
On the near side of the moon, in an area called Mare Crisium
Near the lunar south pole
About 160 kilometers from the lunar south pole
questions.evidence: The spacecraft touched down March 2 on the part of the moon’s near side called Mare Crisium.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 Blue Ghost가 달의 앞면(지구를 향한 면)의 Mare Crisium 지역에 착륙했다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as one of the five countries that have achieved successful moon landings?
options: Russia
Japan
France
China
questions.evidence: Only five countries can claim successful moon landings: Russia, the United States, China, India and Japan.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 언급된 다섯 나라는 러시아, 미국, 중국, 인도, 일본이며 프랑스는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the passage about the cost of NASA's moon missions using private companies compared to past astronaut missions?
options: Private missions cost more because they use advanced robotics
Private missions are cheaper because they operate robotically and companies work within limited budgets
Private missions cost the same as astronaut missions because both require billions of dollars
NASA no longer pays for any part of private lunar missions
questions.evidence: In the past, NASA’s successful moon landings involving astronauts cost billions of dollars. But Firefly chief Jason Kim said the private companies now building and launching spacecraft have a limited budget and the spacecraft operate robotically.
questions.explanation_ko: 과거 유인 달 착륙은 수십억 달러가 들었지만, 민간 기업은 제한된 예산으로 로봇처럼 작동하는 우주선을 운용한다고 했으므로 비용이 더 저렴함을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention the Athena and Resilience landers in the passage?
options: To criticize NASA for wasting money on multiple missions
To show that other private companies are also attempting moon landings as part of ongoing lunar exploration efforts
To explain why Blue Ghost's mission failed
To compare the cost of each mission in detail
questions.evidence: Another lander, called Athena, is set to attempt a moon landing on March 6.
questions.explanation_ko: 저자는 Athena와 Resilience를 언급하여 다른 민간 기업들도 달 착륙을 시도하고 있다는 점을 보여주고 있습니다.

questions.stem: In the sentence "The spacecraft touched down March 2 on the part of the moon’s near side called Mare Crisium," what does "touched down" mean?
options: Crashed
Landed
Launched
Orbited
questions.evidence: The spacecraft touched down March 2 on the part of the moon’s near side called Mare Crisium.

blanks.sentence_ko: 그 우주선은 3월 2일 달의 앞면 중 Mare Crisium이라 불리는 지역에 착륙했다.
그 성공적인 착륙으로 Firefly는 충돌하거나 큰 문제 없이 달에 우주선을 착륙시킨 최초의 민간 기업이 되었다.
그 프로그램은 비용을 줄이기 위해 국가의 주요 우주 임무를 민간 기업에 넘기는 것을 목표로 한다.
그녀는 AP에 최근의 발사들이 우리가 더 많은 과학을 우주와 달로 보낼 수 있는 완전히 새로운 방법을 열어준다고 말했다.
Firefly의 대표 Jason Kim은 현재 우주선을 제작하고 발사하는 민간 기업들이 제한된 예산을 가지고 있으며 우주선이 로봇처럼 작동한다고 말했다.

key_points: Firefly Aerospace's Blue Ghost lander successfully landed on the moon on March 2, making it the first private company to do so without crashing.
The lander touched down in Mare Crisium on the moon's near side and carried 10 NASA experiments.
Only five countries have achieved successful moon landings, and Firefly is the first private company to succeed.
The mission is part of NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) program, aimed at reducing costs by using private companies.
Other private companies, including Intuitive Machines and ispace, are also attempting moon landings around the same time.
Private missions are cheaper than past astronaut missions because they use robotic spacecraft and operate on limited budgets.
main_idea: A private American company, Firefly Aerospace, successfully landed its Blue Ghost spacecraft on the moon carrying NASA experiments, marking a milestone in NASA's effort to use private companies for cheaper lunar missions.
restate_sentence: The program aims to turn over the country’s major space missions to private companies to reduce costs.
